steps.title: PostgreSQL Same-Tenant Ownership Read-Back
steps.description: Confirm enrolment row is owned by student1 under pilot tenant
steps.query: SELECT id, status, student_id FROM stu.enrolments WHERE tenant_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND id = 'a1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000031' AND student_id = '81dd67d3-1d5f-4d8e-8061-a67648610002'

steps.title: RLS Forced On Enrolment Tables
steps.description: Verify FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY remains active on stu enrolment tables
steps.query: SELECT c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'stu' AND c.relkind = 'r' AND c.relname LIKE 'enrol%' AND c.relforcerowsecurity = true

steps.title: Negative RBAC — Unauthenticated Gateway Blocked
steps.description: API Gateway blocks unauthenticated GET to enrolment detail with HTTP 401
